packs.name: FL LUA Controller Scripts
packs.author: FL LUA
packs.description: MIDI controller scripts: knobs to the selected channel, faders to the mixer, pads that always play the drums.

plugins.name: Knobs to the selected channel
plugins.description: CC 21–28 / 70–77 move the selected channel's first eight parameters

plugins.name: Faders to the mixer
plugins.description: CC 7 on MIDI channel n moves mixer insert n (channel 16: the master)

plugins.name: Pads play drums
plugins.description: Notes on MIDI channel 10 go to the first FPC or Drum synth channel

packs.name: FL LUA Drum Machines
packs.author: FL LUA
packs.description: DM-8 and DM-9: analog-style drum machines synthesised in real time, on General MIDI notes, with level, tune and decay for every drum.

plugins.name: DM-8
plugins.description: Analog-style drum machine with a long booming kick, congas, cowbell and claves (General MIDI notes)

plugins.name: DM-9
plugins.description: Punchy analog-style drum machine with a clicky driven kick, bright snare, crash and ride (General MIDI notes)

packs.name: FL LUA Effects
packs.author: FL LUA
packs.description: Soft Clipper, Maximizer, Hyper Chorus, Waveshaper, Overdrive, Delay Bank and Pitcher: mastering, character and vocal tools.

plugins.name: Soft Clipper
plugins.description: Drive into a smooth clipper: tanh, cubic, arctan or hard-knee curve, with oversampling

plugins.name: Maximizer
plugins.description: One-knob three-band loudness maximizer with a look-ahead limiter (reports its latency)

plugins.name: Hyper Chorus
plugins.description: Up to eight modulated delay voices spread across the stereo field

plugins.name: Waveshaper
plugins.description: Eight transfer curves: soft, hard, fold, sine fold, diode, Chebyshev 3 and 5, steps

plugins.name: Overdrive
plugins.description: Tube, crunch or fuzz with a focus pre-filter, asymmetry, tone and low cut

plugins.name: Delay Bank
plugins.description: Four delay taps, each with its own time, level, pan, feedback and damping; tempo-synced or free

plugins.name: Pitcher
plugins.description: Monophonic pitch corrector: snaps a voice or lead to a scale (reports its latency)

packs.name: FL LUA Keys
packs.author: FL LUA
packs.description: E-Piano, Strings, Piano and Choir: playable keyboard instruments synthesised in real time.

plugins.name: E-Piano
plugins.description: Tine electric piano: FM with velocity bark, bell and stereo tremolo

plugins.name: Strings
plugins.description: String ensemble: detuned saws, gentle filter, stereo ensemble chorus

plugins.name: Piano
plugins.description: Soft piano: additive strings with inharmonicity, two strings per note and a hammer

plugins.name: Choir
plugins.description: Formant choir: several singers per note, vowels a–e–i–o–u, vibrato and breath

packs.name: FL LUA Sounds
packs.author: FL LUA
packs.description: Fifty samples made by code: drum-machine kicks, snares, claps, hats, percussion, basses, synth stabs and pads, vocal vowels, FX and 120 BPM loops.

packs.name: FL LUA Synths
packs.author: FL LUA
packs.description: Acid Bass, Tri-Osc, Chip and Additive: four generators for basses, leads, game sounds and evolving pads.

plugins.name: Acid Bass
plugins.description: Monophonic bass with a resonant ladder filter, accent (velocity above 80%) and slide (overlap two notes)

plugins.name: Tri-Osc
plugins.description: Three oscillators with sync, ring modulation and FM, a multimode filter and two envelopes

plugins.name: Chip
plugins.description: Console-style pulse, triangle and noise voices with arpeggio, sweep, vibrato and bit reduction

plugins.name: Additive
plugins.description: Up to 64 partials with tilt, odd/even balance, a formant, inharmonicity and a morph between two spectra
